node_user(("Photo browser user"))

node_user -->|"uses"| node_window
node_startup -->|"opens"| node_window
node_startup -->|"opens"| node_database

node_startup -->|"sets up"| node_logs
node_window -->|"starts scans"| node_scan_thread

node_scanner -->|"matches sidecars"| node_takeout

node_file_processing -->|"writes thumbnails"| node_thumbnail_cache

node_window -->|"manages albums"| node_albums

node_grid_data -->|"queries photos"| node_database
node_grid_data -->|"loads remaining rows"| node_grid_query
node_grid_data -->|"loads thumbnails"| node_thumbnail_cache
node_grid_data -->|"provides grid data"| node_photo_grid
node_photo_grid -->|"uses geometry"| node_grid_layout
node_window -->|"opens selected photo"| node_viewer
node_viewer -->|"shows details"| node_info_panel
node_viewer -->|"loads photo details"| node_database
